title: Valley Equipment opened 1966 in Industrial park, short man, Louis Robichaud. Later owned by the Raymond Cook family since 1978
description: Valley Equipment Limited originally operated out of the J. Clark and Son building on Main Street before relocating to a new facility in the Industrial Park on January 20, 1966. The new metal building, valued at $50,000, arrived in pre-painted sections and was assembled to measure 100 by 50 feet. On January 1, 1970, Raymond Cook became manager, with an option to buy into the business if it proved profitable. He acquired a 5% stake over the first two years, then purchased 40% in 1975, and by 1978, he owned 100%. In the accompanying photo, Joe Palmer, Louis Robichaud, and Ralph Bard (in the white shirt) are identified, while the others remain unnamed.
